lines.text: When a killer is unknown, the nearest city's elders break a heifer's neck in an unplowed valley by a stream.
The elders wash their hands over the heifer and say they did not shed the blood, and it is atoned for.
A captive woman must shave her head, then live in his house a full year before becoming his wife.
A father must give the unloved wife's firstborn son the family house and all its land.

wrong_details.wrong: the family house and all its land
wrong_details.true: a double portion of all that he has

lines.text: A man executed and hung on a tree must be buried that day, because he is under God's curse.
